notes.claim: A solution of a system of two linear equations is an ordered pair that makes both equations true.
The Marine Electro-Technology syllabus examines Kirchhoff's-law problems solved by simultaneous equations with two unknowns only.

sources.title: 4.1 Solve Systems of Linear Equations with Two Variables - Intermediate Algebra 2e | OpenStax
sources.quote: To solve a system of two linear equations, we want to find the values of the variables that are solutions to both equations. In other words, we are looking for the ordered pairs that make both equations true.

sources.title: Marine Electro-Technology Written Examination Syllabus - GOV.UK
sources.quote: 9. Solves problems using Kirchhoffs laws by application of simultaneous equations (two unknowns only).
